title: The Green Forest
text:
The forest is green and big. Many trees live there, and birds sing in the morning. A small river runs through the forest. Animals drink water from the river.

People must help nature. We should not throw trash on the ground. We can walk or ride a bike to save energy. Trees give us clean air.

questions.text: Why do people walk or ride a bike, according to the passage's message?
options: To go to the mountain only
To stop the birds from singing

questions.text: What can we guess about the forest if people protect it?

vocabulary.definition: a large area with many trees
a large amount of water that flows across the land
tall plants with a trunk and branches

paragraph_translations: El bosque es verde y grande. Muchos árboles viven allí, y los pájaros cantan por la mañana. Un río pequeño atraviesa el bosque. Los animales beben agua del río.
Las personas deben ayudar a la naturaleza. No debemos tirar basura en el suelo. Podemos caminar o andar en bicicleta para ahorrar energía. Los árboles nos dan aire limpio.
